description: Investigate an incident from bounded telemetry queries to the deployed revision and the implicated code, and check the note; it proposes a mitigation, never runs one.

create.description: Post the checked note on the incident, replaced in place, and add a timeline line (through the actions log); needs --draft.

draft.description: Investigation note (Markdown) to check: every part, the stage's artefact, cited evidence, two hypotheses, bounded queries, and a mitigation only proposed from the catalog.

environment.description: Deployment environment to scope to; default the deploy marker's.

from.description: Window start (RFC 3339, UTC); default an hour before the incident started. The window is at most 7 days.

query.description: Run one more bounded query and log it as qN: <kind> [by f,…] [where k=v …] [limit N] [bucket 5m].

revision.description: Deployed revision; default the deploy marker serving the window, else service.version on the spans.

service.description: Service to scope every query to; default the only service in the export.

telemetry.description: Sanitised OpenTelemetry export directory: traces.jsonl (OTLP JSON), logs.jsonl (JSON lines with trace_id), deploys.jsonl (deploy markers); read with no network.

to.description: Window end, exclusive (RFC 3339, UTC); default the export's last record.

title: investigate
